reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is coordinating external AI models for second-opinion and adversarial code review, task delegation, and background job handling.

summaries.zh: 通过配置的外部 AI 模型提供代码第二意见审查、对抗性审查、任务委托和后台任务管理。
summaries.en: Uses configured external AI models for second-opinion and adversarial code reviews, task delegation, and background job management.

capabilities: Sends selected code, files, and optionally conversation history to configured external AI endpoints
Performs read-only code and adversarial reviews
Delegates tasks to external AI models and can inject returned results into the session
Runs background jobs with status, result, and cancellation controls
Reads workspace-relative files and persists rescue threads locally
Uses configured API keys and environment variables for external model access
